item: Thermal emergency kit (hand warmers, emergency blankets) accessible on every EVA
rationale: The incident records only that EVA duration was adjusted and extra layers worn as wind reached about 10 m/s and temperatures fell to single digits in late July. The mission brief (its lesson column, not the crew) recommends that a thermal emergency kit of hand warmers and emergency blankets be accessible on every EVA, since temperature drops fast in late July.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.2 Meteorological incidents, lines 611-616, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column
